reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service! They took great care of my cat while I was on a holiday. They posted videos of her on Instagram and it was so fun getting to see the videos while I was away. They also gave me a report and some printed photos of her when I picked her up. I know they made her feel safe and relaxed during her stay. I think she had a great time at AloPets! Sammie will be back if I go on holiday again!
They took good care of our cat for a full month as we traveled. Thank you so much! I am always happy to see the pictures they send too.

I always feel at ease leaving my pet in their care.

The staff are very polite.

The hotel is clean, comfortable, and a lovely space.

You can see updates on how your pet is doing while they're in their care on Instagram.

We've had our ferret stay here many times.

We were recommended by the vet, and we always feel at ease.

The rooms are clean and bright, and they keep us updated on how our ferret is doing on Instagram.

After we leave, our ferret acts as if nothing happened, roaming freely at home and sleeping as usual.

It must be very comfortable for him, as he doesn't seem to experience any stress. They provide daily reports and photos, and I think it's a truly excellent hotel.

The owner is also kind, has a long history of working with ferrets and cats, and is very knowledgeable, which gives us peace of mind.

My beloved cat was taken such good care of during our move.
It was her first time at a hotel, and she was nervous on the first day, but when I went to pick her up the next day, I was surprised to see that she, who is usually shy around strangers, had become completely affectionate towards the staff!
Seeing her expression, I could tell she had a wonderful time.
Thank you so much for the detailed report and even the photos…😿 I will cherish them forever🍀
Thank you so much for everything.
I would definitely like to use your services again if the opportunity arises.
